ui_bugs.component: Dashboard.jsx — Chapter IV EvidenceFeed + Chapter V PassportPreview
ui_bugs.issue: Dashboard @ 375px still overflows: document.scrollWidth=484 (109px over). Investigation shows the LifeOfSong strip is correctly wrapped in overflow-x-auto (L255) and is NOT the source. Real offenders are the outer wrappers `<div className="lg:col-span-2">` at Dashboard.jsx L177 (wrapping <EvidenceFeed/>) and L189 (wrapping <PassportPreview/>), which render at 460px wide because their child cards force intrinsic content width. The EvidenceFeed card header row at L449 (`px-6 py-4 ... flex items-center justify-between`) and the LI items at L461 (`px-6 py-4 flex items-start gap-4`) both measure 458px wide at 375px viewport, indicating the parent grid cell is being pushed by content. Likely fix: add `min-w-0` to the `<div className="lg:col-span-2">` wrappers on L177 and L189 (grid children default to min-width: auto which prevents shrinking below content), and/or add `min-w-0` on the EvidenceFeed root `<div className="border border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-950/40">` at L448. PassportPreview outer at L189 also warrants same treatment.

Identity-color avatar chips render correctly inside EvidenceFeed rows (Dashboard.jsx L462 uses inline style={{ background: c.hex }} — verified in source). My initial selector-based DOM query missed them because they use inline style rather than a data-testid or identifying class. Not a regression — reporting so the next test agent knows to select by CSS `[style*="background"]` inside `[data-testid=dashboard-active-sessions]` or add a `data-testid=identity-chip` for reliable QA.

action_items: Add `min-w-0` to the grid children on Dashboard.jsx lines 177 and 189 (`<div className="lg:col-span-2">`) — this is the standard CSS Grid/Flex fix for children pushing past their track. Without min-w-0, a grid item defaults to min-content and refuses to shrink, causing the ~109px document overflow at 375px. Consider also adding `min-w-0` on the plain `<div>` siblings at L180 and L192.

Optionally add `data-testid="identity-chip"` to the EvidenceFeed avatar div (Dashboard.jsx L462) and any similar identity chips on /sessions and /vaulta to make future palette/identity regression tests robust.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of remaining /dashboard mobile overflow: CSS Grid children (Dashboard.jsx L177, L189) default to `min-width: auto` (aka min-content), which prevents the grid cell from shrinking below the intrinsic content width of nested EvidenceFeed / PassportPreview cards. Result: the grid cell forces 460px width at a 375px viewport, causing the document to scroll horizontally. Standard fix is `min-w-0` on the grid child so its min-width becomes 0 and it can shrink to the track size. The Life-of-Song strip fix (overflow-x-auto + minWidth: 640) is applied correctly and independently verified to not be the cause.
